value.title: Complete Movie
value.synopsis: In the morning, Conan notices a suspicious man watching Amuro at the Cafe. Later, on his way home from school, he spots the same man. Believing something must be up if Conan is interested in him, Mitsuhiko, Genta, and Ayumi follow the man. Conan warns Amuro that the man may be a member of the Black Organization...
